tasks.title: GatewayProvider protocol + implementations
tasks.description: Create backend/src/providers/ package. Define GatewayProvider protocol in providers/gateway.py: async chat_completion(messages, model_hint, task_metadata) -> dict. Implement BSGatewayProvider (routes through BSGateway API with X-BSNexus-* headers) and LiteLLMDirectProvider (direct litellm.acompletion fallback). Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: GatewayProvider protocol defined. BSGatewayProvider sends requests to configured BSGateway URL with task metadata headers. LiteLLMDirectProvider calls litellm directly. Tests verify both implementations with mocked HTTP/LLM calls.

tasks.title: SupervisorProvider protocol + implementations
tasks.description: Define SupervisorProvider protocol in providers/supervisor.py: async log_event(agent_id, event_type, data) -> None, async check_permission(agent_id, action) -> bool. Implement BSupervisorProvider (HTTP client to BSupervisor API) and NoOpSupervisorProvider (does nothing, always allows). Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: SupervisorProvider protocol defined. BSupervisorProvider sends events to configured URL. NoOpSupervisorProvider is a no-op that always returns True for permissions. Tests verify both.

tasks.title: KnowledgeProvider protocol + implementations
tasks.description: Define KnowledgeProvider protocol in providers/knowledge.py: async get_sot(project_id) -> dict, async store_result(task_id, result) -> None, async search(query, limit) -> list[dict]. Implement BSageProvider (HTTP client to BSage /api/knowledge/* endpoints) and LocalMarkdownProvider (reads/writes local ./knowledge/ markdown files). Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: KnowledgeProvider protocol defined. BSageProvider calls BSage API. LocalMarkdownProvider uses local filesystem. Tests verify both with mocks.

tasks.title: Provider config via pydantic-settings
tasks.description: Add provider selection to settings: GATEWAY_PROVIDER (bsgateway|litellm, default litellm), SUPERVISOR_PROVIDER (bsupervisor|noop, default noop), KNOWLEDGE_PROVIDER (bsage|local, default local). Add URL configs: BSGATEWAY_URL, BSUPERVISOR_URL, BSAGE_URL. Update .env.example. Write tests.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Settings has provider selection fields with defaults. .env.example documents all new config keys. Tests verify provider selection from env vars.

tasks.title: FastAPI dependency injection for providers
tasks.description: Create provider factory functions and register as FastAPI dependencies. get_gateway_provider(), get_supervisor_provider(), get_knowledge_provider() resolve the configured provider. Inject into routes/services. Write tests.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Providers available via Depends(). Fallback providers work without external services. Tests verify DI wiring.

tasks.title: Code review — fix all issues including minor ones
tasks.description: Review all changes. Verify: each provider file self-contained, no cross-provider imports, all fallbacks work, test coverage >= 80%, ruff clean.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ruff check passes. pytest coverage >= 80%. All existing tests pass.
